title: Mind over Malignancy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Psychological Distress, Coping, and Therapeutic Interventions in Oncology.

answer.design_quote: In Phase 1, random-effects models synthesized Hedges’ g effect sizes within each intervention category (structured psychotherapeutic, mindfulness-based, and coping/resilience-focused) via restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation of between-study variance (τ 2 ).
answer.k_quote: Ultimately, 42 RCTs satisfied all criteria and were included in the narrative synthesis and meta-analysis.
